items.title_zh: 债市巨震！信用债抛压集中释放 机构：调整不改宽松基调
items.summary: On 30 October the domestic bond market saw a sudden, concentrated correction, with yields on city-investment bonds and liquid bank perpetual and tier-2 capital bonds rising fast on significantly heavier volume.
items.summary_zh: 10月30日，国内债券市场突发集中调整，城投债以及流动性较好的 银行 二永债等多品种收益率快速上行，成交显著放量

items.title: Fourth batch of mutual fund benchmark changes lands, giving more products a clear reference

items.summary_zh: 今日晚间，千余只公募基金集中发布业绩比较基准调整公告，公募基金第四批业绩比较基准调整正式落地

items.title: Tech giants need legacy businesses to keep growing as they pour trillions into the AI buildout
items.title_zh: 科技巨头向 AI 基建投入数万亿美元，却仍需传统业务维持增长

items.summary_zh: 超大规模云厂商持续在人工智能上大举投入，给传统业务带来压力并影响自由现金流。

items.title: A decade of data: the Shanghai Composite rose in November 60% of the time, with micro and small caps outperforming; where do valuations stand now?

items.title: Fourth batch of mutual fund benchmark changes completes, with more than 4,000 products adjusted
items.title_zh: 公募基金第四批业绩比较基准调整落地 超4000只产品完成调整安排
items.summary: On 30 October, as the fourth batch of a thousand-plus existing funds published benchmark notices, the number of products requiring unified adjustment in the transition period passed 4,000.
items.summary_zh: 10月30日，随着第四批千余只存量公募基金集中发布业绩比较基准调整公告，过渡期内需统一调整的产品已超4000只

items.title: Japan's 'national team' to accelerate ETF sales, having offloaded 244 billion yen this year
items.title_zh: 日本“国家队”将加速抛售ETF 年内已卖2440亿日元
items.summary: The Bank of Japan said today that from January it will raise annual ETF sales to about 860 billion yen at book value, from about 330 billion yen, shortening the time needed to complete the unwind from roughly 112 years to about 43 years.
items.summary_zh: 日本央行今日宣布，从明年1月起，按账面价值计算， 每年出售ETF的规模提高至约8600亿日元 （约363亿元），此前为每年约3300亿日元（约139亿元），完成全部出售的时间预计由约112年缩短至约43年

items.title: Interview with SGX group managing director Chen Qing: regional allocation to renminbi assets is turning longer-term

items.summary_zh: 海外投资者配置人民币债券，又多了一种选择

items.title: At 4.9 yuan per thousand calls, Baidu wants to push search API pricing to the floor
items.title_zh: 千次4.9元，百度这回想把搜索API打到地板价
items.summary: On 30 October Baidu held a product upgrade briefing in Beijing, launching a new round of upgrades around its Ernie assistant, AI camera, GUI interaction and AI interactive content, and upgrading its search AI API for developers.
items.summary_zh: 10月30日，百度App在北京举办产品升级沟通会，围绕文心助手、AI镜头、GUI交互和AI互动内容推出新一轮升级，同时升级搜索AI API，面向开发者提供搜索服务

items.title: MetaX: first-three-quarter net profit attributable to shareholders 639 million yuan, turning profitable

items.summary: MetaX reported 2026 first-three-quarter revenue of 2.824 billion yuan, up 128.45%, and net profit attributable to shareholders of 639 million yuan versus a 346 million yuan loss a year earlier; recurring net profit was 259 million yuan, also turning profitable.
items.summary_zh: 沐曦股份公告，2026年前三季度营业收入28.24亿元，同比增长128.45%；归母净利润6.39亿元，上年同期亏损3.46亿元，扭亏为盈；扣非净利润2.59亿元，扭亏为盈

items.title: Gen Z is ditching bars for run clubs — and finding more than friends along the way
items.title_zh: Z 世代抛弃酒吧转向跑步俱乐部，顺带收获的不只是朋友
items.summary: As young adults denote less wallet share to bars, run clubs, races and recreational leagues become increasingly popular places to build community.
items.summary_zh: 随着年轻人把更少的支出投向酒吧，跑步俱乐部、赛事和休闲联赛正成为越来越受欢迎的社群场所。

items.title: China's live hog price falls below 9 yuan per kilogram; will the cycle turn?

items.summary_zh: 10月以来，生猪市场延续旺季不旺态势，国内生猪价格继续下行

items.title: YOFC: first-three-quarter net profit attributable to shareholders 6.128 billion yuan, up 1,204.63%
items.title_zh: 长飞光纤：前三季度归母净利润61.28亿元，同比增长1204.63%
